summary: The TMP auto-size settings that actually mean "wrap first, then shrink, never overflow", in one component.
overview: TMP supports auto-sizing, but it takes several settings configured together — auto-sizing on, min and max font size, word wrap, and an overflow fallback — to behave the way people expect. This is exactly that bundle with clear fields.
useCases: Item and ability names of varying length in a fixed box.
Localised text where translations are longer than the original.
Any label that must never overflow its container.

params.tuning: The real decision. Set too low and long text becomes technically visible and practically unreadable.
On means wrap before shrinking, which keeps text larger. Off forces a single line and shrinks harder.

gotchas.title: Shrinking is not always the right answer
gotchas.body: For a long name in a narrow strip, scrolling reads better than tiny text — MarqueeText is the alternative.
